name: go2_walk_turn_walk
title: Go2: walk -> turn-in-place -> walk (VERIFIED 2026-07-17, free-standing)
summary: The first free-standing quadruped BATON sequence with a turn leg: walk:10 -> turn:5 (~169 deg in place at the lut's achieved 0.5895 rad/s) -> walk:10 on the reversed heading. Verified 3/3 headless runs, zero falls, deterministic, both policies' 'ONNX loaded:' asserted; no harness (quads carry none). The turn leg is the go2_turn champion certified the same day (99.2% never_fell); the walk and stand legs are the verified go2_walk_stand_walk stack. See the `verification` field for the exam record.

deploy.notes: A `world` deploy: ONNX controller in its own process, env EXPORTED by skill_lib. BATON_SPECIALISTS assembles from the skills list as 'turn|<onnx>|<turn lut>|0;stand||<stand lut>|0' -- the controller's own setdefault is overridden. go2_stand is listed even though the schedule never enters 'stand' because the controller FATALs without GO2_STAND_LUT; it also gives the demo a parking mode for free if the schedule is extended.

handover_feasibility.walk_to_turn: Both legs are cyclic locomotion attractors on the SAME clock (nb=64, freq=1.8, shape parity asserted by the luts' shared joints order), so resolve_handover derives WARM -- and warm/cold is moot anyway: both policies are feedforward ONNX MLPs with no hidden state. The binding constraint is the SUPPORT GATE, unchanged from the verified demo: the turn gait shares duty=0.6 phase structure with the walk, so the four-foot-support windows the host computes from the gait model fall at the same phases for both legs. The switch waits for max swing weight <= GO2_SUPPORT_TOL exactly as walk->stand did after the t=12.83 s flip taught us why.
handover_feasibility.turn_to_walk: Symmetric to the above. One turn-specific check the exam MUST make: heading after the turn leg is arbitrary by design, so leg-2 progress must be scored along the ACHIEVED heading (the G1's walk_turn_walk keep-heading lesson), not along +x -- a straight leg 2 at 169 deg looks like NEGATIVE x progress to a naive |x| ruler.
handover_feasibility.morph: BATON_MORPH_TICKS=30 crossfades glut/ref/ffdq element-wise between the walk and turn luts at the same phase; mid-morph the blend is a partial-rate turn, which is itself a legal differential-stride gait (the sweep is linear in wz to first order). The wz obs value must crossfade with the SAME u (deploy hook 2) or the policy sees a command that disagrees with its reference.

expected: leg 1: ~3.5-4 m at +x (0.38-0.43 m/s after ramp). turn:5 at wz_meas 0.5895 rad/s ~= 169 deg IF the residual tracks the ghost's rate; the solo exam measures the actual per-leg yaw gain first (the G1 turner's measured live gain was ~0.67 -- plan the schedule from the MEASURED gain, not the ghost's). leg 2: straight on the achieved heading, 0 falls, 2 switches.

verification.result: 3/3 headless runs, zero falls, deterministic: walk +4.2 m, turn in place ~169 deg over 5 s with position pinned, then walk 10.9-13.1 m on the reversed heading. Both policies asserted loaded via two ONNX loaded lines.
verification.requirements: The launcher must honour caller BATON_SPECIALISTS/BATON_SCHEDULE and use controller-readable absolute checkpoint paths on Windows.
